limitations: Mood thresholds for thrilled/needs-attention/very-unhappy states are not exercised because reaching them requires many clicks beyond the action limit.
CSS-drawn appearance (colors, shapes) is not pixel-verified; only visibility is checked.
Keyboard focus styling and responsive layout at 360px are not tested.
Bar fill transition animation timing is not asserted beyond a short wait.

# Pixel Virtual Pet

A simple offline browser app featuring a CSS-drawn pixel creature with hunger, happiness, and energy bars. Use the Feed, Play, and Sleep buttons to interact with your pet and watch its mood change.

## Features

- CSS-drawn pixel pet
- Three status bars: Hunger, Happiness, Energy
- Mood text updates based on average status
- Keyboard-accessible buttons with visible focus states
- Responsive layout down to 360px wide
- No external dependencies, fully offline

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. Click or use keyboard (Tab + Enter) to activate the buttons.

## Files

- `index.html` – main structure
- `styles.css` – styling and pet drawing
- `script.js` – game logic
